summary.text: Father of Peiros, leader of the Thracians who came from Aenus to fight beside Troy — distinct from the river Imbrasus on Samos named in the Argonautica.

story.text: Peiros, son of Imbrasus, that had come from Aenus, was leader of the Thracians when he cast the jagged stone that crushed Diores' ankle; Thoas of Aetolia thereafter ran upon him and pierced his breast beside the nipple.
